answer_text:
Let

\[
I_n=\int_0^{\pi/4}\tan^n\left(\frac{x}{n}\right)\,dx.
\]

Set \(a=\frac{\pi}{4}\). For \(x\in[0,a]\), write

\[
\tan^n\left(\frac{x}{n}\right)
=\left(\frac{x}{n}\right)^n
\left(\frac{\tan(x/n)}{x/n}\right)^n.
\]

For small \(u\),

\[
\frac{\tan u}{u}=1+\frac{u^2}{3}+O(u^4),
\]

so

\[
\log\left(\frac{\tan u}{u}\right)=O(u^2).
\]

Thus there exists a constant \(C>0\) such that, for all sufficiently large \(n\) and all \(x\in[0,a]\),

\[
1\le \left(\frac{\tan(x/n)}{x/n}\right)^n
\le \exp\left(C\frac{x^2}{n}\right)
\le \exp\left(C\frac{a^2}{n}\right).
\]

Therefore,

\[
\int_0^a \left(\frac{x}{n}\right)^n dx
\le I_n
\le \exp\left(C\frac{a^2}{n}\right)
\int_0^a \left(\frac{x}{n}\right)^n dx.
\]

Now

\[
\int_0^a \left(\frac{x}{n}\right)^n dx
=\frac{1}{n^n}\int_0^a x^n dx
=\frac{1}{n^n}\frac{a^{n+1}}{n+1}.
\]

So

\[
\left(\frac{a^{n+1}}{n^n(n+1)}\right)^{1/n}
\le I_n^{1/n}
\le \exp\left(C\frac{a^2}{n^2}\right)
\left(\frac{a^{n+1}}{n^n(n+1)}\right)^{1/n}.
\]

Multiplying by \(n\), we get

\[
n\left(\frac{a^{n+1}}{n^n(n+1)}\right)^{1/n}
\le n I_n^{1/n}
\le \exp\left(C\frac{a^2}{n^2}\right)
n\left(\frac{a^{n+1}}{n^n(n+1)}\right)^{1/n}.
\]

But

\[
n\left(\frac{a^{n+1}}{n^n(n+1)}\right)^{1/n}
=
\frac{a^{1+1/n}}{(n+1)^{1/n}}
\longrightarrow a.
\]

Since \(a=\frac{\pi}{4}\), the squeeze theorem gives

\[
\lim_{n\to\infty} n\left[\int_0^{\pi/4}\tan^n\left(\frac{x}{n}\right)dx\right]^{1/n}
=\frac{\pi}{4}.
\]

\[
\boxed{\frac{\pi}{4}}
\]
